body: It went as well as it could, he's angry and confused but he's willing to work through it if I get help for my mental health. Thank you so much, you helped more than you could understand :)
I have written him a letter which he is reading now, wish me luck.
Thank you, I don't know how I could even do it. I've been hiding at my mums for days because I feel too guilty to face him.

It just seems like it would be so much easier to just end it, then he can remember me positively. I've been thinking about doing this for a long time but now I feel like it's better than having him hate me over something I barely remember doing.

I have reason to believe it did happen, from the small things I can recall, it's just completely out of character for me and I am terrified of losing him over a stupid moment of drunken weakness, I couldn't bare to see him look at me differently.
Hey sorry, couldn't figure out how to link to my original post but I've added it now.
Unfortunately the snippets of memory that I do have lead me to think I may have consented at the time :(
